data.description:
Inconsistency between the Herdr in_review stage filter and the ship release gate:

- The ship skill queries "wl list --stage in_review" with NO status filter (check-audit-gate.js, check-final-validation.js, generate-changelog.js), so a status=blocked item in the in_review stage (e.g. WL-0MTF5WO1N0088P5P) IS seen by the release gate and blocks the release.
- The Herdr in_review stage filter (fetchItemsByStage -> STAGE_STATUS.in_review = "completed,in-progress,open") EXCLUDES status=blocked items, so the same item never appears in the in_review filtered selection list.

The user-facing symptom: an in_review item that blocks the release is invisible in the /wl review view, so the selection list and the release gate disagree about what is in the review queue.

User story: As a Herdr user, I want the in_review filter to show every root item the ship release gate sees in in_review, so the selection list and the release gate agree on the review queue.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. fetchItemsByStage(in_review) issues a wl list query whose status filter includes blocked alongside completed/in-progress/open (verified by a unit test asserting the exec args).
2. A status=blocked root item at stage=in_review appears in the stage-filtered in_review list.
3. Other stages keep their existing status rules unchanged.
4. The stage-filter documentation (STAGE_STATUS comment in fetcher.ts, worklist.ts doc, packages/herdr/README.md) reflects that in_review includes blocked items.
5. Build passes and the herdr package test suite is green.

Notes:
- Root cause: STAGE_STATUS.in_review omits blocked. The project workflow (AGENTS.md, WL-0MSKCRX730052IIW) documented blocked as excluded, but the release gate does not exclude it — the exclusion makes release-blocking items invisible in the review filter.
- Fix: STAGE_STATUS.in_review = completed,in-progress,open,blocked. discovered-from:WL-0MV6TFX0600145M2
data.title: Herdr in_review filter hides blocked items that the release gate treats as release-blocking

data.comment: Implementation: STAGE_STATUS.in_review changed from 'completed,in-progress,open' to 'completed,in-progress,open,blocked' in packages/herdr/src/fetcher.ts, so the Herdr in_review filter matches the ship release gate's unfiltered 'wl list --stage in_review' (check-audit-gate.js / check-final-validation.js). Tests updated: stage-status.test.ts (args now include blocked + new test that a blocked in_review item survives the filter) and worklist.test.ts (fetchItemsForView in_review includes a blocked item). Docs updated: STAGE_STATUS + fetchItemsByStage JSDoc, worklist.ts fetchItemsForView doc, packages/herdr/README.md in_review section. Verification: full herdr suite 104 files / 3422 tests green; build clean. Live confirmation: 'wl list --status completed,in-progress,open,blocked --stage in_review --root-only' now returns WL-0MTF5WO1N0088P5P.
